content:
emma_auditor: Quick ask from the auditor: they want a tight evidence package for control mapping around the RINF-2026-42 vuln triage (affects inference-routing). Deliverables: RBAC change history for service principals, KMS access (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) during incident window, and a short incident->runbook tie-back. Also state whats explicitly out-of-scope. Can we ship by EOD?

leo: I can pull RBAC diffs and k8s audit slices. Which window?

emma_auditor: Window = 2026-02-20T00:00:00Z -> 2026-02-22T23:59:59Z. Production only for control assertion; call out any staging overlap.

dina: I'll do KMS/CloudTrail exports. Note: one key used by inference-cache is in account 999999999999 (dedicated tenant); cross-account logs are not in our main CloudTrail. I'll include the cross-account request ticket IAM-8421 and mark as "external" in the manifest.

leo: RBAC artifacts I plan to drop: 
- repo: git://git.redwood/infra/kubernetes/rbac
- PRs: 5512 (add inference-router-sa), 5570 (temp oncall grant)
- k8s-audit slice saved to s3://redwood-prod-logs/k8s-audit/2026-02/rINF-42/rolebinding-slice.json
Splunk query Ill run: 
```splunk
index=\"k8s_audit\" source=\"k8s:apiserver\" earliest=\"2026-02-20:00:00:00\" latest=\"2026-02-22:23:59:59\" | search objectRef.name=\"inference-router*\" OR verb=\"create\" OR verb=\"patch\"
```
That will show who created/modified rolebindings.

emma_auditor: Good. Auditor asked about humans vs service accounts for elevated bindings. Please flag any human principals.

leo: quick note: PR 5570 added oncall@redwood (human alias) to cluster-admin for emergency; edit was audited in PR notes. I'll include the PR diff and the merge commit.

ops-bot: archive-job: started bundle collection for thread=7319998888 -> target=s3://redwood-audit-bundles/7319998888/ status=running

dina: For KMS I'm running: 
```bash
# CloudTrail lookup for KMS events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-02-20T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-02-22T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].{Time:EventTime,ARN:Resources[0].ARN,User:Username}'

# list keys referenced in Lambda envs for inference
aws lambda list-functions --query 'Functions[?contains(FunctionName,`inference`) == `true`].{Name:FunctionName,Env:Environment.Variables}'
```
I found two keys: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1111 and arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/external-2222 (external account).

emma_auditor: Include key metadata (describe-key) and any Grant/Decrypt events. If any key material rotation happened, mark in manifest.

leo: Also recording a small timeline.csv mapping timestamp,actor,action,evidence_link. Example row: 2026-02-21T14:12:03Z,service:inference-router-sa,rolebinding:create,s3://.../rbac-create-1412.json

emma_auditor: Auditor also wants checksums for deterministic snapshots. SHA256 per file.

leo: I'll produce a manifest.txt with SHA256(artifact) entries and a brief statement: "Production scope only; staging shares no service principals except inference-staging-sa (out-of-scope)."

ops-bot: archive-job: uploaded 5 artifacts (rbac-prs.zip, k8s-audit-slice.json, kms-events.csv, timeline.csv, manifest.txt) status=partial

mfa-bot: security: found 2 MFA events during window for user 'oncall@redwood' at 2026-02-21T13:58:00Z and 2026-02-21T14:05:12Z — logs stored at s3://redwood-security/mfa-events/2026-02/rINF-42-mfa.json

emma_auditor: Perfect. Call out the oncall human use and that temp access was used per audit entries. Also include short note whether 2FA was completed.

dina: Caveats to include in manifest: 
- cross-account KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/external-2222 -> logs located in account 999999999999; we submitted IAM-8421 to request for audit copy; currently marked "pending".
- retention window: k8s-audit has 90-day retention; older lines outside window may have been sampled.
- sampling: k8s-audit slice filtered to objectRef.name prefixed with "inference" to keep bundle small.

leo: ETA: RBAC artifacts + manifest in 90 minutes. dina: KMS exports + key describes in ~2 hours. I'll stitch timeline quickly after.

emma_auditor: Thanks. I'll relay to auditor: expected bundle links in ~3 hours. Auditor wants explicit "out-of-scope" list in top-level executive_summary.txt.

ops-bot: archive-job: progress=80% thread=7319998888

dina: Final note: I'll compute SHA256 for each file and include as manifest.md lines like: 
sha256: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08  rbac-prs.zip

emma_auditor: Great. Please ping me when presigned URLs are ready. :thumbsup:
